segments.sn17.8:1.1: Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati … pe …“dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … adhigamāya.
segments.sn17.8:1.3: Assuttha no tumhe, bhikkhave, rattiyā paccūsasamayaṃ jarasiṅgālassa [siṅgālassa (ka.), jarasigālassa (sī. syā. kaṃ.)] vassamānassā”ti?
segments.sn17.8:1.5: “Eso kho, bhikkhave, jarasiṅgālo ukkaṇḍakena [ukkaṇḍakena (sī.), ukkaṇṇakena (syā. kaṃ. pī.)] nāma rogajātena phuṭṭho neva bilagato ramati, na rukkhamūlagato ramati, na ajjhokāsagato ramati;
segments.sn17.8:1.6: yena yena gacchati, yattha yattha tiṭṭhati, yattha yattha nisīdati, yattha yattha nipajjati; tattha tattha anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn17.8:1.7: Evameva kho, bhikkhave, idhekacco bhikkhu lābhasakkārasilokena abhibhūto pariyādiṇṇacitto neva suññāgāragato ramati, na rukkhamūlagato ramati, na ajjhokāsagato ramati;
segments.sn17.8:1.8: yena yena gacchati, yattha yattha tiṭṭhati, yattha yattha nisīdati, yattha yattha nipajjati; tattha tattha anayabyasanaṃ āpajjati.
segments.sn17.8:1.9: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko … pe … evañhi vo, bhikkhave, sikkhitabban”ti.

lines: Yathā hi suvaṇṇavaṇṇopi kāyo pūtikāyo tveva, taṃkhaṇaṃ gaḷitampi ca muttaṃ pūtimuttantveva vuccati, evaṃ tadahujātopi siṅgālo jarasiṅgālotveva vuccati.
Tasmiṃ uppanne sakalasarīrato lomāni patanti, sakalasarīraṃ nillomaṃ hutvā, samantato phuṭati, vātabbhāhatā vaṇā rujjanti.
Yathā ummattakasunakhena daṭṭho puriso anavaṭṭhitova bhamati, evaṃ tasmiṃ uppanne bhamitabbo hoti, asukaṭṭhāne sotthi bhavissatīti na paññāyati.
